params.name: parameters
params.description: Object containing the web area's attributes (url, area, onEvent, autoQuit, timeout, result, plus custom attributes); the command adds a 'timeoutReached' property to this same object.

overloads.semanticRole: The WA Run offscreen area command creates a web area in memory which can be used to automatically load and parse web pages.

constraints: parameters is mutated by the command: it automatically adds a 'timeoutReached' Boolean property (true if the timeout elapsed) that callers can read after the callback returns.
The offscreen Web area only exists for the duration of this command's execution and is destroyed automatically once it completes.
Defaults inside parameters: autoQuit = true (stop on On End URL Loading/On URL Loading Error), timeout = 60 seconds (0 = no limit).
If parameters is null, a blank offscreen Web area is created and then immediately closed.
